summary_zh: 将单次 Claude Code 会话扩展为游戏开发工作室式协作环境：49 个专业子代理（涵盖设计、程序、美术、音频、叙事、QA、制作等），按总监、部门主管、专员三层组织，配 74 个斜杠命令覆盖头脑风暴、系统设计、架构、故事与冲刺、评审、测试、发布等流程，并提供钩子校验与规则约束。
audience_zh: 适合使用 Claude Code、希望让 AI 辅助游戏开发更有结构的人：独立开发者、小型团队，以及想从构思到发布保持设计文档、评审与 QA 流程的 Godot、Unity 或 Unreal 项目作者；默认最低配置追求小游戏速度，可按需提升流程强度。

evidence.quote: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.

**Claude Code Game Studios** solves this by giving your AI session the structure of a real studio. Instead of one general-purpose assistant, you get 49 specialized agents organized into a studio hierarchy — directors who guard the vision, department leads who own their domains, and specialists who d

Building a game solo with AI is powerful — but a single chat session has no structure. No one stops you from hardcoding magic numbers, skipping design docs, or writing spaghetti code. There's no QA pass, no design review, no one asking "does this actually fit the game's vision?"
The result: you still make every decision, but now you have a team that asks the right questions, catches mistakes early, and keeps your project organized from first brainstorm to launch.
